correctness.rationale: The nine triangles are defined by the associative three-object composition. c3,c4,c5 are private edges in three diagonal triangles and collapse. The six offdiagonal faces have every retained edge in exactly two triangles, and each of the three vertex links is a six-cycle; this is a connected closed surface. Euler characteristic is 0 and the explicit parity obstruction at c1 prevents orientability, forcing Klein bottle. H1 torsion rules out all <=2 object acyclic categories. An exact checker was run and the Smith normal form of the 12-by-9 boundary is (1 eight times,2).

value.rationale: The exact minimum object count of the Klein bottle, a natural first closed nonorientable aspherical surface, evaluates the target invariant beyond the studied projective-space and Moore-space examples. The explicit associative category compresses a nonabelian aspherical surface group with first homology torsion to three objects; it is not a change of normalization, isolated arbitrary parameter slice, or routine special case of a source theorem.
